cases.prompt: Here's a rough idea for a feature. Work it up into a ticket I can hand to an implementer.
cases.expected_behavior: ready-ticket runs its elicitation and terminates in a ticket body. superpowers:brainstorming may inform the questioning, but the run must not re-enter open-ended ideation after the ticket's intent is settled, and must not hand off to writing-plans.
cases.why_it_matters: The registry records this borrow as bounded: it takes the questioning discipline and stops at brainstorming's step 9 handoff, because ticket authoring is house-owned. If the peer re-triggers past that boundary the seam has failed open.
